The '''Silorna system''' was located in the [[Imberlin sector/Legends|Imberlin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] known as the [[Silorna Force Crystal]].<ref name="Shadows">{{LivingForce|Shadows in Green}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Silorna Force Crystal]]|system=Silorna [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Silorna [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square P-13.<ref name="TEA" />
